title: Visual Regression Matrix
objective: Menguji ukuran referensi, breakpoints, density, themes, scaling, long text, missing icons, loading, dan error states.

measurements: 1536x1024 renders the wide_desktop frame without an exception
left navigation, main grid, right rail and status bar all resolve
cells.note: Viewport comes from AccountCenterWideDesktopFrame.referenceWidth/Height (115.45), not a local constant.

measurements: 1440x900 resolves the wide_desktop tier and renders its frame
no overflow exception at the 1440 breakpoint edge
cells.note: 1440 is the wide_desktop lower bound in spec.layout.breakpoints[0].min_width_px.

measurements: 1180x900 resolves the desktop tier with adaptive left navigation
wide_desktop frame keys are absent below 1440
cells.note: 1180 is the desktop lower bound in spec.layout.breakpoints[1].min_width_px (drawer rail, 115.46).

measurements: 900x1200 resolves the compact_desktop tier with the collapsed rail
no overflow exception on the two-column overview
cells.note: 900 is the compact_desktop lower bound in spec.layout.breakpoints[2].min_width_px.

measurements: 600x1200 resolves the tablet tier with top navigation
no overflow exception on the scrollable tab strip
cells.note: 600 is the tablet lower bound in spec.layout.breakpoints[3].min_width_px.

measurements: 390x844 resolves the mobile tier and renders account-center-mobile-layout
no overflow exception below the 600px boundary
cells.note: 390x844 is a named probe size, not a spec number; the canonical assertion is the tier, and any width under 599 reaches the same chrome.

measurements: 10 Void theme families (ink/ember/sage/rose/ocean x dark/light) repaint the Scaffold background
each family renders without an exception at 1536x1024
cells.note: Measured through the palette extension the chrome reads via context.palette; a hardcoded dark ink would leave the scaffold on the default palette.

measurements: TextScaler.linear(2) keeps the '+ Add Another Method' target at 44px height
200% expansion produces no overflow exception
the chrome subtree reads a TextScaler of 2.0 (10 scaled to 20), so the cell cannot pass on a dropped parameter
cells.note: Scale bound is AccountCenterAccessibility.maximumSupportedTextScale (115.7), which transcribes spec accessibility.requirements[5]. PITFALL measured on this step: the first version of the pump helper accepted a `scaler` argument and never installed it, so the cell asserted at scale 1.0. A deliberate mutation (forcing TextScaler.noScaling) still left the 44px touch-target assertion green and only the new MediaQuery read failed with Expected 20 / Actual 10.0 - the original assertion was a rubber stamp.

measurements: long account mode, display name, email and every service label render at 1536x1024 without overflow
the same long snapshot renders at 390x844 without overflow
cells.note: Text expansion surface only; no RTL/IME locale content is claimed (see deferred_external).

measurements: provider 'mega' is registered without a bundled mark and resolves hasBundledAsset=false
the chrome renders the generic icon and announces 'Mega icon unavailable'
cells.note: Entry forced AVAILABLE so the tile actually renders; the fallback name comes from ProviderIconEntry.accessibleName (115.8). Brand licensing for real marks stays DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

measurements: a pending operational-metrics provider renders both loading strings
a failing operational-metrics provider renders the error copy without throwing
cells.note: Covers the metrics provider only; provider-side RATE_LIMITED/OUTAGE/REAUTH surfaces need a live connector and stay DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

defects_fixed: AccountCloudSnapshot.service() uses firstWhere without orElse, and the chrome asked for 'email-sign-in' in three places (AUTHENTICATION card, rail card, plan resolver), so a snapshot without that entry threw StateError: Bad state: No element and the whole page failed to render. Added serviceOrNull/connectionStateOf and routed all three call sites through it; a missing entry now degrades to 'Not connected'.
deferred_external: Native screen-reader certification (NVDA/JAWS/TalkBack/VoiceOver) and measured contrast ratios are platform gates; the matrix covers Flutter semantics labels, not the platform AT stack.
Real brand marks: bundling an official provider asset depends on provider licensing review, so only registered-but-unbundled entries are exercised here.
Provider-side error states (RATE_LIMITED, OUTAGE, UNSUPPORTED_REGION, REAUTH_REQUIRED) need a live connector response and cannot be rendered honestly in a local widget test.
Hosted CI visual-diff baselines, per-OS DPI scaling beyond the Flutter text scaler, and RTL/IME content packs are external to this build.
Publisher/brand-license certification for shipping provider marks is a legal review, not a local test.
overlap_note: Cells overlap by design: the six size cells each also exercise rendering, the long-text cell renders at two viewports, and error_states and missing_icon both drive the live chrome. Counts are per cell and must not be summed across cells.
